title: Ethiopia: Partying like it's 1992
text: As the western world approaches the millennium, according to the Ethiopian calendar it is still 1992. The country's unique calendar and timekeeping create a fascinating cultural divide.

title: De-mining in the Horn
text: A year ago, Laeke Mariam Demessie visited the front line in the war with Eritrea — recently he returned to see the Ethiopian army consolidate its control over captured territory.

title: Ancient alphabet enters cyber age
text: The alphabet used in Ethiopia and Eritrea is Africa's oldest. Laeke Mariam Demessie reports on the efforts to get the 276-letter script into the digital world.

title: Battle in the Horn: Touring the Front Lines
text: On-the-ground dispatch from the Ethiopia-Eritrea border war. Laeke toured captured trenches with Ethiopian forces, interviewed captured Eritrean soldiers, and documented the brutal reality of trench warfare in the Horn of Africa.

title: SCIENCE: Africa Loses Scientist and Genetic Rights Campaigner
text: With the death of Dr. Akilu Lemma, Africa has lost a scientist whose life and work illustrated the difficulties faced by African researchers and Africa's fight for genetic rights.

title: Eritrea: Monetary Divorce From Ethiopia
text: Although it fought a long war of independence against Ethiopia, Eritrea had kept using the Ethiopian birr after becoming Africa's newest nation in 1993 — but it has now adopted a national currency, the nakfa.

title: Sudan Peace Talks Collapse as Rebels Walk Out
text: Talks to end the unbridled violence that has killed tens of thousands in Sudan's Darfur region collapsed with two rebel groups charging the government had not kept its end of the bargain. AP wire dispatch from Addis Ababa, syndicated to newspapers across the United States.

title: Sudan, rebels work to set agenda for talks
text: Sudan and two rebel groups worked to set an agenda for talks aimed at ending 17 months of fighting across the nation.

title: Darfur peace talks collapse as rebels walk out
text: African Union-sponsored talks to end the slaughter of tens of thousands of people in Sudan's western Darfur region collapsed as rebels walked out.

title: Talks to end slaughter in Darfur put on hold
text: Talks to end the unbridled violence that has killed tens of thousands of people in Sudan's western Darfur region collapsed Saturday, putting peace efforts on indefinite hold.

title: Sudan and rebels begin peace talks
text: Sudanese officials and rebels began peace talks Thursday to end 17 months of fighting in Sudan's Darfur region, where U.N. officials say tens of thousands have died.

title: Ethiopia Stuck in Telecoms Stone-Age
text: Ethiopia has only 150,000 telephone lines for a population of 56 million; and only 1,300 internet subscribers. In telecommunication terms, this is a disaster.

title: Biodiversity & Bio-Piracy — The Case of Ethiopia
text: Biodiversity conservation and bio-piracy are hot issues of debate and dialogue between the techno-rich Northern developed and the biodiversity-rich Southern developing countries.

title: Progress report on street culture in Ethiopia
text: This paper deals with the social, economic and cultural aspects of Ethiopian society which contribute to the emergence of street corner groups and the adjustment techniques adopted by street boys.
